description: The direct source audit found the remaining general library surfaces needed to retain the current Elixir telemetry analyzer shape: collection length and map size, Enum.zip_with/2 and Enum.with_index/1, tuple element projection, type predicates used by cell formatting, the JSON module spelling, and fixed-precision float rendering at the original call site. Add only the general APIs that the direct port proves necessary, with a cross-door contract.
title: Close remaining direct Distill core-library gaps
